tagline: Spain's leading global financial services group
hero_kpi_rationale: BBVA's primary revenue, heavily influenced by interest rates and credit growth, is the main driver of its financial performance in the banking sector.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the difference between interest received and interest paid.
kpis.description: Net interest income rising due to strong credit activity and favorable interest rate environment.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by customer activity.

kpis.name: Net Fees and Commissions
kpis.explanation: Revenue from banking services charged to customers.
kpis.description: Growth sustained by customer activity and digitalization.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Cost reduction and strong digitalization drive.

kpis.name: Cost of Risk
kpis.explanation: Expected loan losses relative to total loans.
kpis.description: Modest increase in defaults despite economic environment.

kpis.name: CET1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of the bank's financial soundness.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Total assets at 859,576 M€ as of December 2025.

kpis.name: Loans to Customers
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans extended to customers.
kpis.description: Gross loans at 472,697 M€ end of 2025.

kpis.name: Customer Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of deposits held by the bank.

kpis.name: Active Clients
kpis.explanation: Number of customers actively using the bank's services.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share distributed annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years disclosed by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.696 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years disclosed.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $4.196 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 39.9% last year.

kpis.name: Digital Sales
kpis.explanation: Share of sales conducted through digital channels.

kpis.name: Mobile Clients
kpis.explanation: Number of customers using the bank's mobile application.

risks.title: Concentrated geopolitical exposure: Spain-Mexico-Turkey
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at top of Item 3D with precise figures (53.1% / 21.2% / 10.6% of assets). Strong language: 'material adverse effect', 'exceptionally high uncertainty'. Upward trend linked to US-China tensions, Ukraine, Middle East and Latin America.

risks.title: Rising multi-jurisdictional regulatory and tax risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned among key business risks: 'increasing tax burden', 'capital, resolution, liquidity, provision and consumer protection requirements'. Present across multiple filing sections. Upward trend with new ESG and prudential requirements.

risks.title: Neobank competition and technology obsolescence risk
risks.score_rationale: Cited by name: 'rise of neobanks (a new generation of financial institutions that operate exclusively online)' and 'ability to manage information technology obsolescence'. Positioned in strategic business risk section. Rising trend with accelerating digitalization.

risks.title: Cyber-attacks and information system failures
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'security breaches, including cyber-attacks and identity theft' and 'weaknesses or failures in the Group's internal or outsourced processes, systems (including information technology systems)'. Dedicated Item 16K on cybersecurity confirms weighted importance. Structurally rising risk in banking sector.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration strategy risks
risks.score_rationale: Directly cited: 'the success of our acquisitions and investments, divestitures, mergers, joint ventures and strategic alliances'. 2025 context marked by active M&A (Sabadell acquisition underway). Moderate language but concrete execution risk.

risks.title: ESG, climate and institutional reputation risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'physical, regulatory, reputational, transition and business risks associated with climate change and emerging and developing ESG standards'. Presence in emerging markets assessed at 'higher ESG risk levels'. Strong European regulatory trend upward.

risks.title: AML, anti-corruption and sanctions compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited: 'weaknesses or failures of our anti-money laundering or anti-terrorism programs' and 'compliance with applicable anti-corruption laws and sanctions regulations'. Operations in emerging markets with elevated AML risk (Mexico, Turkey). Strong language on potential consequences.

risks.title: Hyperinflationary environment in Turkey and Argentina
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in financial presentation section with IAS 29 application since 2022 (Turkey) and 2018 (Argentina). 'Liraization strategy' and negative real rates in Turkey cited as specific risks affecting margins. Stable trend but structurally constraining.

ai_positioning.summary: BBVA is progressively integrating AI into customer services and operations, without positioning itself as a technology leader. Focus is on incremental innovation.
evidence: Strategy: 'Unlock the Potential of AI and Innovation'
Focus on digitalization and customer experience
Absence of mention of specific AI models or APIs in the document
